summary: Private, no operator web page: twinvalleycampground.com is parked, Facebook has no posts, RoverPass listing NOT bookable (unclaimed). Price rests on the dated Campendium camper report ($38, Nov 16 2025, site 90), allowed because there is no operator page; note now says CAMPER-REPORTED RATE. Presence passes on Google Maps (3.8 from 65 reviews, phone (330) 739-2811). Cleared directory-only hookups/sites (107, 40 ft, water/sewer). Workforce/long-stay leanings in reviews.
flags: GATE: price is camper-reported only - $38 a night (Campendium, Nov 16 2025, 2 nights, site 90); the operator posts no rate (no website, Facebook with no posts). Under $50. No gateway within 40 km (Pittsburgh 84 km). Not in the stored Good Sam data as a GS Park. Google Maps 3.8 from 65 reviews; phone (330) 739-2811 (matches stored).

PRESENCE: passes on Google Maps alone (open, 65 reviews, phone); no website. Facebook page (70 followers, 'No posts available', 86% recommend from 6 reviews) lists twinvalleycampground.com, which redirects to ww17.twinvalleycampground.com - a parked above.com domain. RoverPass listing: isBookable false (unclaimed directory listing, request-to-book), so its rate table doesn't count. Suggest dropping the RoverPass URL from website (Facebook stays as the only operator page) - the brief says Facebook alone is weak.

LONG-STAY / WORKFORCE leaning (test 2 is the soft spot: no nightly rate posted by the operator anywhere; only the camper report): Google review summary 'My boyfriend was in the area for work and stayed here for two weeks'; review a year old: 'Abandoned campers and buildings everywhere ... people leaving at 6am in broken down trucks with no muffler ... We were just looking for a safe and quiet place to overnight while on the road. Site was uneven in a grassy field. No website so I should have seen the red flags.' Recent reviews (2-3 months ago) are families on summer camping trips. Seasonal-site share unknown (no operator page).

Pin 40.5312,-80.9863 sits at the entrance road junction; the campground runs SE from there and Google's point (40.53089,-80.98482) is 130 m ESE inside the site rows. Within tolerance; Google's point is a better centre if moved.
Directory amenities not stored (Campendium: 30/50 A, full hookups, pull-thru, dump, laundry, showers, pool, Passport America, Escapees) - none confirmed by the operator.
